# V1.6.8 — Balance widget fix release

**Charter (reset 2026-07-22):** this doc is now the **v1.6.8 release** — a single-fix release carrying the balance-widget durable fix (Item 10, `8e32677`) that landed *after* the v1.6.7 cut. Its earlier life as the "not-yet-ready holding batch" is retired: the three items it was holding (Item 1 delete-account web setup, Item 4 custom fonts, Item 41 Play Store screenshots) were **all moved to [v1.6.9.md](v1.6.9.md)** on 2026-07-22, keeping their original numbers per the traceability convention.

**Status:** RELEASED to closed testing 2026-07-22 (versionCode 11 / versionName 1.6.8, `8e32677`) — but **shipped with an undiscovered regression**: the balance widget's own eye/refresh buttons were completely dead on the real R8-minified build (Glance `ActionCallback` reflection needs an explicit constructor keep-rule R8 full mode was stripping; Item 10 was only ever verified on the unminified emulator, which structurally can't catch this class of bug). Root-caused from Alvin's real-device logs and fixed 2026-07-23 as [v1.6.9.md](v1.6.9.md) Item 46 — **v1.6.9 (versionCode 12) supersedes this release.**

## Item 10 — Balance widget: session-race empty state, in-app→widget privacy desync, tiny touch targets

*(re-homed here 2026-07-22 from [v1.6.7.md](v1.6.7.md) — this fix landed after the v1.6.7 cut, so it ships as the v1.6.8 release. Commit/history still read "v1.6.7 Item 10" — immutable; number kept for that traceability.)*

- **Status:** ✅ **DONE `8e32677`** (2026-07-22, Opus, medium effort, on-device verified — emulator, Claude driving, tfvin24@gmail.com; Alvin approved the flow). The shipped scope grew well past the original 4-bug plan below — the real root cause turned out to be the widget gating **local** reads on the **live** Supabase session (null on a cold/backgrounded process) and blocking each render up to 8s on it. See the **Follow-up** section at the end for the durable fix and the full shipped list. No schema/Room change.
- **Request:** Alvin asked for an on-device pass of the Balance & accounts home-screen widget (install → log in as tfvin24@gmail.com → background → delete+recreate the widget → tap the eye) because he'd been seeing inconsistent behavior. Reproduced and root-caused four distinct bugs during that session (emulator, Claude driving), plus a fifth found when Alvin separately resized the widget himself.
- **Bugs found (on-device, emulator, tfvin24@gmail.com — real net assets ₱46,512.75 / 7 accounts confirmed in-app via Manage → Accounts):**
  1. Tapping the widget's eye reveals **₱0.00**, not the real balance (~2s visible lag before it updates at all).
  2. Resizing the widget taller — meant to show a per-account breakdown per the widget picker's own "resize to see each account" description — instead renders **"No accounts yet"** with the extra space unused.
  3. Revealing amounts in-app (Manage → Accounts eye) does **not** repaint the widget — backgrounding right after still shows the widget masked.
  4. The eye and refresh tap targets are small enough to miss in normal use (Alvin: "it's very small, a user will most likely not be able to click it appropriately").
- **Root cause (confirmed via code read, see investigation below — all in [feature/widget/](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/) except one repo file):**
  - **Bugs 1+2 share one cause.** `provideGlance()` in [BalanceWidget.kt:102-119](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt) waits on the auth SDK session via `withTimeoutOrNull(SESSION_LOAD_MS) { ... }` (lines 110-114) but **discards the result** — whether the wait succeeds or times out, it falls through and reads `netAssetsUseCase()`/`accountBalancesUseCase()` unconditionally. If the session hasn't restored yet, `AccountRepositoryImpl.observeAccounts()` legitimately emits `emptyList()` for a null `userId` ([AccountRepositoryImpl.kt:31-35](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/accounts/data/AccountRepositoryImpl.kt)) — not a hardcoded placeholder, a real (unhandled) race. `TallWidget`'s `"No accounts yet"` hint ([BalanceWidget.kt:217](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt)) is correct code reacting to genuinely-empty upstream data. **This exact race was already patched once** ([v1.6.6.md Item 36](v1.6.6.md#item-36) — "follow-up fix G," noted then as unreproducible on emulator since session restore was ~30ms there) — reproducing it again now means either a regression in that fix or a new trigger path; root-cause fresh rather than just widening `SESSION_LOAD_MS` again.
  - **Bug 3** is a one-line gap in an established pattern: `PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.setEnabled()` ([PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.kt:52-54](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/data/PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.kt)) just flips the in-memory `StateFlow` with no `widgetRefresher.refresh()` call — the auto-lock re-hide path right above it (lines 38-47) already calls `widgetRefresher.refresh()` after changing the same flag; `setEnabled()` needs the same call.
  - **Bug 4:** refresh icon is a bare 18dp `Image` with `clickable` directly on it, no sizing box ([BalanceWidget.kt:248-255](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt)); the eye's clickable `Box` is declared 48×36dp ([BalanceWidget.kt:283-298](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt)) — both under the 48dp minimum on at least one axis. (On-device `uiautomator` measured the eye's exposed touch node at ~53×53px/~24dp — smaller than the declared box; re-measure after the fix in case that's a real Glance hit-region issue and not just an unlabeled inner-`Image` accessibility bound.)
- **Change:**
  1. [BalanceWidget.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt) `provideGlance()` (~L102-119) — stop discarding the `withTimeoutOrNull` result. If the session doesn't resolve to `Authenticated` within `SESSION_LOAD_MS`, render an explicit loading/retry state instead of falling through to a zero balance, and trigger a follow-up `Widgets.updateAll()` once the session later resolves (rather than leaving the widget stuck on the empty snapshot until the next unrelated write). Root-cause why this races on this build even though Item 36 supposedly fixed it — check for a regression before touching the timeout value.
  2. [PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/data/PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.kt) `setEnabled()` (~L52-54) — add the same `widgetRefresher.refresh()` call the auto-lock path already makes (~L38-47), so every in-app privacy toggle repaints the widget immediately.
  3. [BalanceWidget.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt) — wrap the refresh icon (~L248-255) in a ≥48×48dp clickable `Box` matching the eye's existing pattern; bump the eye's `Box` (~L283-298) height 36dp → 48dp (width already 48dp). Re-check with `uiautomator` post-fix that the exposed clickable bounds actually grew, not just the declared modifier.
  4. No change to `SizeMode.Responsive`/`buildAccountRows` ([WidgetDisplay.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/WidgetDisplay.kt)) — that logic is correct and already unit-tested (`BuildAccountRowsTest`); it was only ever starved by the bug-1 data race.
- **Verify:** build green (`assembleStagingDebug`/`installStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest`); on-device (`ondevice` skill) on tfvin24@gmail.com or another real account with a nonzero balance: (1) fresh app launch → background → add/recreate the widget → eye reveal shows the **real** net assets, no ₱0.00, no multi-second lag; (2) resize taller → real per-account rows appear, not "No accounts yet"; (3) reveal in-app (Manage → Accounts or any Item-7 eye) → background → widget already reflects revealed state without an extra tap; (4) `uiautomator` bounds check confirms both the eye and refresh clickable regions measure ≥48dp on both axes. **Tier-1 test:** extend/add a JVM test around the `provideGlance` timeout-handling branch if it can be isolated from the Glance rendering (e.g. a pure function for "decide loading vs. data vs. empty given auth-wait outcome"); `PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.setEnabled()` gains a test asserting `widgetRefresher.refresh()` is invoked (MockK, matching the existing auto-lock-path test if one exists).

### Follow-up (2026-07-22, grilled on-device with Claude) — the durable root fix: local reads must not wait on the live session

- **Status:** ✅ **DONE `8e32677`**. **Model: Opus, medium effort.** No schema/Room change.
- **Everything that shipped under Item 10 (`8e32677`):**
  1. **Persisted-id fallback (the fix that stuck):** [AccountRepositoryImpl.observeAccounts](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/accounts/data/AccountRepositoryImpl.kt) and [TransactionRepositoryImpl.observeBalanceLedger](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/data/TransactionRepositoryImpl.kt) resolve `currentUser.userIdOrNull() ?: lastActiveUser.lastUserId()`; [BalanceWidget.provideGlance](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt) computes its readiness gate off the same resolved id (via a new `WidgetEntryPoint.lastActiveUserStore()`). [LastActiveUserStore](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/session/LastActiveUserStore.kt) gained a `NONE` no-op (test/default seam).
  2. **Removed the 8s blocking session wait** in `provideGlance` (and the dead `SESSION_LOAD_MS`) — it stalled every cold render and made the manual ⟳ need several taps before it applied (Alvin). Renders are now immediate; remote freshness comes from background sync, not from stalling the render.
  3. **Honest interim state + self-heal** (Fixes A/B/E): a `NotReady`/"Updating…" placeholder in [WidgetDisplay.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/WidgetDisplay.kt) instead of a false ₱0.00; [WidgetSessionHintWriter](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/data/WidgetSessionHintWriter.kt) repaints on the session-present transition; new [BalanceWidgetRetryWorker](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidgetRetryWorker.kt) polls (capped backoff) for the genuinely-not-ready case.
  4. **Widget eye is its own domain** (Alvin's call): reveal formula is `revealed = userToggled` only — dropped the `globalHide` coupling — and [PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/data/PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl.kt) no longer repaints the widget on an in-app privacy toggle or on auto-lock (reverted the Fix-C coupling + the pre-existing auto-lock widget re-mask). The in-app "Hide amounts" flag scopes to in-app surfaces only.
  5. **2×2 minimum size** — [balance_widget_info.xml](../../app/src/main/res/xml/balance_widget_info.xml) `minHeight` 64→110dp, `targetCellHeight` 1→2.
  6. **Larger tap targets** — refresh wrapped in a 48×40dp box (was a bare 18dp glyph); eye box 48×36→48×40, glyph 24→26dp.
  7. **Login-sync ordering** — [MainActivity](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/MainActivity.kt) enqueues the durable background `SyncWorker` *before* the awaited foreground `syncEngine.sync()`, so a stalled sync or a ROM force-stop can't strand the first pull.
- **Tests added:** `WidgetDisplayTest` (NotReady + widget-own-eye truth table), `BuildAccountRowsTest` (NotReady suppression), new `WidgetSessionHintWriterTest` (repaint-on-authenticated), `AccountRepositoryImplTest` + `TransactionRepositoryImplTest` (persisted-id fallback + empty-when-no-id). `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green.
- **On-device (emulator, Claude driving, tfvin24@gmail.com / Alvin approved):** instrumentation proved a cold render went `userId=null accounts=0` (stuck) → after the fix `userId resolved accounts=7` and painted the account list on a cold, force-stopped process with no foreground. Residual, expected: a brief "No accounts yet" during the genuine first-sync-after-wipe window (heals when accounts land; ~a minute on the slow emulator, faster on-device). Temp `BalanceWidgetDbg` logging was stripped before commit. **Original follow-up plan (kept for the record):**
- **What the earlier fixes got wrong:** Fixes A/B/E made the empty state *honest* ("Updating…") and added a retry worker, and the widget-eye decoupling + 2×2 sizing + login-sync ordering all landed — but the widget **still** showed "Updating…"/"No accounts yet" after login→background and only healed on foreground. Two rounds of on-device testing with temporary `Log.i("BalanceWidgetDbg", …)` instrumentation in `provideGlance` pinned the exact cause: in the backgrounded/cold widget process the render resolves `hasSession=true sessionReady=false userId=null accounts=0` — i.e. `CurrentUserProvider.userIdOrNull()` (the **live Supabase session**) returns null and stays null (the retry worker keeps re-finding null), while the accounts are **already in local Room**. The widget was blocking local data on the one thing it doesn't need for a local read: the network session's user id.
- **Root fix — resolve the read user id from the persisted [`LastActiveUserStore`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/session/LastActiveUserStore.kt) when the live session is null.** That store is written on every login (`AccountSwitchGuard`), lives in its own DataStore, and survives process death and the sign-out wipe — so a cold process knows *whose* rows to read without waiting on Supabase.
  1. [AccountRepositoryImpl.observeAccounts](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/accounts/data/AccountRepositoryImpl.kt) — `val userId = currentUser.userIdOrNull() ?: lastActiveUser.lastUserId()`.
  2. [TransactionRepositoryImpl.observeBalanceLedger](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/data/TransactionRepositoryImpl.kt) — same fallback (balances need the ledger too).
  3. [BalanceWidget.provideGlance](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt) — compute the readiness gate off the same resolved id so `sessionReady` is true when a persisted id exists; add `LastActiveUserStore` to `WidgetEntryPoint`.
- **Why safe (grilled):** the fallback only fires when `currentUserOrNull()` is null. In-app that happens only (a) during cold-start before the main app mounts (no account-observing screen is composed yet) or (b) during sign-out, where `LocalDataWiper` has already emptied Room → the query returns empty regardless. Signed-out widget stays gated to "Sign in to view" by the session **hint** (`WidgetSessionStore`), independent of the persisted id. Writes are untouched — the strict `userId()` (throws with no session) still stamps rows, so no risk of mis-attributing a write. ADR-0013 user-scoping and ADR-0004 partner redaction unchanged (same DAO `WHERE userId = :id OR coupleId IS NOT NULL`).
- **Verify:** the exact failing scenario — login → immediately background → widget shows the **real account list** on its own, no "Updating…"/"No accounts yet" hang, without foregrounding. Confirm via the `BalanceWidgetDbg` log that `userId` resolves (from the persisted store) even while the live session is null; **then strip the temp instrumentation before commit.** Tier-1: JVM test that both repo reads fall back to the persisted id when `currentUserOrNull()` is null and still emit local rows (MockK).
